notes.title: Cosmantic Cluster Demo Updated
notes.notes:
Cosmantic Cluster's demo has been updated to reflect the full game visually and gameplay wise.

[b]Before[/b]
The demo was originally made using an old build of the game as a template and mainly used to bug test and gather feedback from play testers. Lots of gameplay and visuals have since then changed in the full game. The demo featured the first 5 levels of route 1 and a limited 2p vs mode with a handful of characters and stages.

[b]After[/b]
-Lots of UI elements have been updated such as text bubbles, super gauge, Ui buttons etc.

-Main menu now reflects the one in the full game. With more options and button layouts available and other quality of life improvements. 

-The tip diary and quick tutorials up to purple orbs are available. 

-Lots of tweaks to the gameplay that make it more in line to the full game.   

-Easy mode and hard mode changes.

-The credits are viewable from the main menu.

If you have been on the fence about getting the full game, give the improved demo I try! 
[b]Story progress will not carry over though.[/b]

As usual if you encounter any bugs ether in the demo or the full game please let us know! You can reach out to us on Steam or through our Discord!

Logan

notes.title: Story level patch for orange orbs
notes.notes:
We were made aware of a bug in regards to the orange orbs not appearing in the launchers rotation, in the rematch levels with Ethan and Amie & Aziz. This should now be fixed and orange orbs should now appear. Sorry if this bug caused any issues while playing.

As always please let us know through our Discord if you encounter any bugs while playing. As a side note I will be posting the rest of the soundtrack on my Youtube channel, so come drop by if you would like to listen to any of the music from the game!

Have good day!

Logan

notes.title: Game is still being reviewed by Steam so release is delayed
notes.notes:

notes.title: Steam Next Fest updates so far!
notes.notes:
[b]Steam Next Fest updates so far![/b]

Thank you to everyone who played and wish listed the game! We hope you enjoyed what you played so far and are excited about whats to come. We are in the process of updating the game with the feedback we have received. This post is a list of things that have been updated so far.

[b]- Updated main menu background[/b]

The updated background has an animated night sky for better presentation!

[b]- Control options[/b]

There are now more control options available to choose from, including game pad support! 1p and 2p can now switch control schemes if you want. The controls will take affect once you leave the menu.

[b]- New font for character story text[/b]

We changed the font to something less bland. Please let us know if the new font is still no good or fine.

[b]- Easier to make shots in between orbs  [/b]  

We have adjusted the aimer slightly to make certain shots easier to shoot.

[b]- Added a quit button[/b]

There is now a quit button. You no longer have to go out of full screen to close the game.


[b]Other updates currently being worked on

- Updated UI buttons

- Adjusting certain character voice volume

- Updating current tutorial and new quick tips section

- Ai difficulty

- Performance issues 

- Other UI elements[/b]
